name: product-demo-studio
description: Generate truthful product videos or readiness feedback through deterministic evidence, four independent reviews, release arbitration, remediation, mandatory final independent review and verification, and reproducible delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Produce verified videos or readiness feedback.
interface.longDescription: Consume Product Experience Engineering's current pre-video handoff, then plan, assess, capture, narrate, compose, preflight, independently review, arbitrate, remediate, rerender, and require a mandatory final independent review and verification of truthful product videos. Fail closed to fix-oriented Product-Readiness Feedback when the product or pipeline cannot clear the persuasion, correctness, evidence, privacy, compliance, and reproducibility gates.
defaultPrompt: Assess this product and produce only demo-worthy videos.
Turn this workflow into a persuasive product demo.
Audit this demo proxy against truth, craft, and persuasion gates.
